title: Mutations in the monkeypox virus replication complex: Potential contributing factors to the 2022 outbreak.
authors: Kannan, Saathvik R; Sachdev, Shrikesh; Reddy, Athreya S; Kandasamy, Shree Lekha; Byrareddy, Siddappa N; Lorson, Christian L; Singh, Kamal
one_liner_zh: 该文分析猴痘病毒复制复合体突变并利用AlphaFold结构预测推断突变对DNA结合与互作的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作与结构预测，但对象非TF-DNA体系且互作机制研究较浅。
abstract: Attributes contributing to the current monkeypox virus (MPXV) outbreak remain unknown. It has been established that mutations in viral proteins may alter phenotype and pathogenicity. To assess if mutations in the MPXV DNA replication complex (RC) contribute to the outbreak, we conducted a temporal analysis of available MPXV sequences to identify mutations, generated a DNA replication complex (RC) using structures of related viral and eukaryotic proteins, and structure prediction method AlphaFold. Ten mutations within the RC were identified and mapped onto the RC to infer role of mutations. Two mutations in F8L (RC catalytic subunit), and two in G9R (a processivity factor) were  approximately 100% prevalent in the 2022 sequences. F8L mutation L108F emerged in 2022, whereas W411L emerged in 2018, and persisted in 2022. L108 is topologically located to enhance DNA binding affinity of F8L. Therefore, mutation L108F can change the fidelity, sensitivity to nucleoside inhibitors, and processivity of F8L. Surface exposed W411L likely affects the binding of regulatory factor(s). G9R mutations S30L and D88 N in G9R emerged in 2022, and may impact the interaction of G9R with E4R (uracil DNA glycosylase). The remaining six mutations that appeared in 2001, reverted to the first (1965 Rotterdam) isolate. Two nucleoside inhibitors brincidofovir and cidofovir have been approved for MPXV treatment. Cidofovir resistance in vaccinia virus is achieved by A314T and A684V mutations. Both A314 and A684 are conserved in MPXV. Therefore, resistance to these drugs in MPXV may arise through similar mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 导致当前猴痘病毒（MPXV）暴发的因素仍未知。已确定病毒蛋白中的突变可能改变表型和致病性。为评估MPXV DNA复制复合体（RC）中的突变是否促成此次暴发，我们对可用的MPXV序列进行了时间分析以识别突变，利用相关病毒和真核蛋白的结构及结构预测方法AlphaFold生成了DNA复制复合体（RC）。在RC中鉴定出十个突变，并将其映射到RC上以推断突变的作用。F8L（RC催化亚基）中的两个突变和G9R（一种持续性因子）中的两个突变在2022年序列中约100%普遍存在。F8L突变L108F于2022年出现，而W411L于2018年出现，并在2022年持续存在。L108在拓扑上位于增强F8L DNA结合亲和力的位置。因此，突变L108F可改变F8L的保真度、对核苷抑制剂的敏感性及持续性。表面暴露的W411L可能影响调控因子的结合。G9R中的突变S30L和D88N于2022年出现，可能影响G9R与E4R（尿嘧啶DNA糖基化酶）的相互作用。其余六个突变于2001年出现，并回复到首个（1965年鹿特丹）分离株。两种核苷抑制剂布林西多福韦和西多福韦已获批用于MPXV治疗。痘苗病毒中的西多福韦耐药性通过A314T和A684V突变实现。A314和A684在MPXV中均保守。因此，MPXV对这些药物的耐药性可能通过类似机制产生。
